name: Odoo 20 Business Apps Suite
description: CRM, sales, inventory, invoicing and website in one. Odoo with Postgres.

PORT.description: Port nginx listens on (public domain target). Odoo itself listens on 127.0.0.1:8069/8072.

PGUSER.description: Database user. Must not be 'postgres' (Odoo refuses it).

ODOO_DB_NAME.description: Database Odoo serves (dbfilter and db_name are pinned to it).

ODOO_MASTER_PASSWORD.description: Master password (admin_passwd) protecting the database manager: create, duplicate, backup, restore, drop.

ODOO_ADMIN_LOGIN.description: Login of the administrator user set when the database is created. Use an e-mail address if you prefer.

ODOO_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Password of the administrator user, set once when the database is created. Change it later in Odoo.

ODOO_AUTO_CREATE_DB.description: Create the database on first boot (no demo data). Set false to create it yourself in /web/database/manager.

ODOO_INIT_MODULES.description: Modules installed at database creation, comma-separated (e.g. base,crm,sale_management,stock). Install the rest from the Apps menu.

ODOO_INIT_LANG.description: Extra language loaded at database creation, e.g. de_DE or tr_TR. Optional.

ODOO_UPDATE_MODULES.description: Modules to update on the next start (e.g. all after a patch upgrade). Clear it again afterwards. Optional.

ODOO_LIST_DB.description: Database manager and selector. Keep False in production; set True temporarily to back up or restore from the UI.

ODOO_WORKERS.description: HTTP worker processes (prefork). Rule of thumb: 2 x vCPU + 1. Must be > 0 for /websocket (live chat, notifications).

ODOO_DB_MAXCONN.description: Max Postgres connections per Odoo process. Keep (workers + cron + 1) x this below Postgres max_connections (100).

ODOO_LIMIT_MEMORY_SOFT.description: Recycle a worker after a request once it uses more than this many bytes (768 MiB).

ODOO_LIMIT_MEMORY_HARD.description: Kill a worker immediately above this many bytes (1 GiB).

ODOO_LIMIT_TIME_CPU.description: Max CPU seconds per request (imports and reports need more than Odoo's 60 s default).

NGINX_CLIENT_MAX_BODY_SIZE.description: Max upload size (attachments, imports, database restores).

SMTP_HOST.description: Outgoing SMTP server. Optional: you can also configure mail servers in Settings > Technical > Outgoing Mail Servers.

EMAIL_FROM.description: Default sender address, e.g. odoo@yourcompany.com. Optional.

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Let running requests finish on redeploy.

PGDATA.description: Location where the database will be initialized.

PGDATABASE.description: Required variable for the data panel.

POSTGRES_DB.description: Default database created when image is started.

DATABASE_URL.description: URL to connect to Postgres database.

POSTGRES_USER.description: Superuser created on first boot. 'odoo' instead of the Railway default 'postgres', which Odoo refuses to use.

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Allow Postgres to cleanly shut down.
